steps.description: Implement overlap detection using half-open intervals [s,e)

failure_patterns.reason: ⚠️ Use half-open intervals: s < b and a < e. Using <= incorrectly flags adjacent intervals.

Implement earliest_feasible_time with incremental forward scan (t += 1) from anchor

failure_patterns.reason: ⚠️ Must scan forward incrementally (t += 1). Jumping to gaps misses the true earliest slot.
